title: Define D&D 5e character creation recipe boundary
description:
Introduce the recipe boundary for rule-pack-specific character creation and add the D&D 5e SRD recipe as the first implementation.

Design constraints
- Use one shared CLI shell with rule-pack-specific recipes.
- Do not design a full universal cross-system character schema. Use a minimal draft envelope and D&D-specific typed selections internally.
- Keep Pathfinder future-compatible without implementing Pathfinder now.

The D&D recipe should expose the canonical modes:
- Concept-first — I know what I want to play
- Ability-first — let the dice inspire me

Acceptance criteria
- A CharacterCreationRecipe contract or equivalent seam exists.
- The D&D 5e SRD recipe declares supported modes and step order.
- Recipe code owns D&D terminology, validation hooks, derived-stat hooks, and finalization rules.
- Shared CLI code does not need to know what Fighter, ancestry boosts, hit dice, or spell slots mean.
- Tests prove the D&D recipe can produce the expected step order for both modes.
notes: PR #285 (open for review): https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/285 — recipe boundary + D&D 5e SRD recipe. Internal-only exports; consumed by later slices.
